decisions.reason: Although it fits the bakery's existing bread know-how well, its absence from the website after 2019 suggests weak distinctiveness or replacement by overlapping bread lines, so resources are better redeployed to stronger core products.

The historic mill tour builds on the firm's heritage and facilities, but it is less central than baked goods and the weak recent visibility makes continued learning and commercialization less attractive than focusing on core bakery and hospitality offers.

As a farmhouse bread very close to established recipes, production skills, and customer demand, it benefits from high absorptive capacity and can be refined through routine market feedback at low development risk.

The poppy seed Christmas stollen is a flagship, award-winning product squarely within the firm's traditional confectionery strengths, giving management strong reason to retain and repeat it seasonally.
The premium Christmas stollen is also award-winning and highly related to the firm's existing capabilities, so it is likely to stay unless the range is simplified around the flagship stollen.
